orientation.title: Find your way around
orientation.summary: The screen, the inbox, personas and help in two minutes.

welcome.title: Welcome to Provena
welcome.body: A trading and risk system for guarantees of origin and EU allowances. This short tour shows where things are.

kpis.title: Your figures
kpis.body: The home page shows what matters for your role: open work, positions, valuations and deadlines.

work.title: Your work
work.body: Tasks waiting for you. Middle office approves trades, so this step shows Mia Middle's work. Every approval needs a second person, so the inbox is where most work starts.

entity.title: Legal entity
entity.body: Every screen shows one of your companies at a time. DEMO-FI books in euros, DEMO-SE in Swedish kronor.

search.title: Search
search.body: Jump to a screen, find a trade by number or reference, or search the help: Ctrl K or /.

inbox.title: The inbox
inbox.body: All approvals in one place: trades, plans, curves, invoices, limits and more.

persona.title: Personas
persona.body: In the demo you act as a person with a role. Switch here to play both sides of a four-eyes step.

help.title: Help
help.body: The ? opens the manual page for the screen you are on, and tours like this one.

trade.title: Capture and approve a trade
trade.summary: A trader captures a guarantee of origin sale, middle office approves it.

form.title: Instrument and product
form.body: Choose GoO or EUA and the instrument: forwards, spots, futures and more.

counterparty.title: With whom
counterparty.body: The book and the counterparty. An intercompany counterparty asks for the mirror book of the other company.

pricing.title: Fixed or index
pricing.body: A leg has a fixed price, or follows a price index plus a spread fixed later.

criteria.title: Which certificates
criteria.body: For guarantees of origin, the criteria say which certificates qualify: country, energy source, technology, age, support. On a sale, a hint under each delivery shows how much you can still sell from the certificates held.

capture.title: Capture
capture.body: The trade is checked against limits and waits for approval. Try it: fill in the quantities and capture.

approve.title: Approve as middle office
approve.body: Middle office finds the trade in the inbox. The trader who captured it cannot approve it.

blotter.title: The blotter
blotter.body: Every trade, newest first, with its status. The Open deliveries tab shows what still has to be delivered.

confirmations.title: Confirm a trade
confirmations.summary: Our confirmation, theirs, and what happens when they differ.

list.title: Confirmations
list.body: Their confirmations are matched against ours field by field. Mismatches and disputes show here.

ours.title: Our confirmation
ours.body: Open a trade and use its Confirmations tab to issue our PDF or enter theirs.

break.title: A break
break.body: A mismatch becomes a task for a second person: approve to override, reject to dispute.

inventory.title: Certificates and criteria
inventory.summary: Lots, expiry and finding certificates by criteria.

lots.title: Certificates
lots.body: Every lot is a range of certificate numbers with the same attributes in one registry account.

ladder.title: Expiry ladder
ladder.body: How many MWh expire in each coming month, so nothing is left to lapse.

criteria.title: Criteria
criteria.body: The same criteria builder as on trades: describe what a delivery needs.

search.title: Search
search.body: Find the lots that satisfy the criteria and how many MWh they hold.

allowances.title: Allowances
allowances.body: EU allowances per registry account, with movements and transfers.

allocation.title: Allocate and deliver
allocation.summary: Match certificates to obligations and send them to the registry.

workbench.title: Obligations
workbench.body: Open deliveries and cancellations, with how much of each the inventory can cover.

solver.title: Solver
solver.body: Greedy is fast; the exact solver finds the best plan for constraints like device shares.

whatIf.title: What if
whatIf.body: Try a plan without storing anything. The result shows its value in EUR and the give-away: the premium handed to sales that a more valuable certificate delivers.

propose.title: Propose
propose.body: A proposed plan waits for approval by someone else.

approve.title: Approve the plan
approve.body: Approving reserves the lots and creates the registry instructions.

registry.title: Registry
registry.body: Instructions are sent to the registries and confirmed; failures come back as tasks.

portfolio.title: Products and netting
portfolio.summary: See what is held and owed in each product, and where the portfolio is short once certificates are matched by what they qualify for.

positions.title: Positions
positions.body: The guarantees-of-origin position of the selected entity: coverage, expiry and the table by bucket and vintage.

views.title: Three views
views.body: Position is what is held. Available to sell is what a new sale could still receive. Choose Products to see the portfolio as a tree of product buckets.

products.title: The product tree
products.body: In Products, each row is a bucket, indented under the larger buckets it sits inside. Open a row with its arrow. Long is what is held in the bucket, short is what only the bucket's certificates can serve, and free is what no obligation uses.

netting.title: Naive net or netted
netting.body: Naive net is long minus short and ignores what certificates qualify for. Wind held cannot serve a hydro sale, so a bucket can look long and still be short. Short after netting, in amber, is what must be bought or issued.

alsoUnder.title: In several places
alsoUnder.body: A product can sit inside more than one larger product, for example Nordic hydro inside European hydro and Nordic renewable. It is listed under each, marked also under, with the same figures. Mark, cheapest to deliver and give-away are in EUR per MWh; give-away is a management figure and is never booked.

containedIn.title: Contained in
containedIn.body: On the products screen in administration, the Contained in column shows the same hierarchy for each bucket, and buckets proven to hold exactly the same certificates as same as.

valuation.title: Curves, valuation and P&L
valuation.summary: From market quotes to official curves, valuations and P&L explain.

curves.title: Curves
curves.body: Forward prices by delivery period, built from the quotes of a day.

snapshot.title: Snapshot
snapshot.body: A built curve becomes official when a second person signs it off.

runs.title: Valuation runs
runs.body: Every open trade valued at the official curves of a day.

explain.title: P&L explain
explain.body: What changed between two official runs: new trades, price moves, deliveries and time.

signOff.title: Sign-off
signOff.body: The second risk person signs off curves and runs in the inbox.

risk.title: Limits and breaches
risk.summary: Limits, utilisation and what happens on a breach.

limits.title: Limits
limits.body: Limits by type and scope, with their current utilisation.

measure.title: Measure
measure.body: Measure utilisation now; it also runs on a schedule and on every trade.

request.title: Request a limit
request.body: A new limit or a change needs a second risk person.

breaches.title: Breaches
breaches.body: A breach opens a task to acknowledge or resolve. DEMO-SE has one open.

ets.title: EU ETS compliance
ets.summary: Emissions, free allocation, surrenders and deadlines.

position.title: Compliance position
position.body: Allowances held against emissions to cover, per installation and year.

deadlines.title: Deadlines
deadlines.body: Verification and surrender deadlines, on the calendar and on the home page.

installations.title: Installations
installations.body: The installations with their permits and registry accounts.

emissions.title: Emissions
emissions.body: Open an installation to record estimates and verified emissions; verified ones need a second person.

settlement.title: Invoice, pay and net
settlement.summary: From delivered trades to invoices, payments and netting.

items.title: Settlement items
items.body: Every delivery becomes an item: price, net amount and VAT treatment.

run.title: Run invoices
run.body: Drafts are created per counterparty from the open items.

issue.title: Issue
issue.body: A second accountant issues the invoice from the inbox; it gets its number and PDF.

payments.title: Payments
payments.body: Record payments or import a bank file, then allocate them to invoices.

netting.title: Netting
netting.body: Offset what you owe and are owed with one counterparty, then settle the difference.

monthEnd.title: Close the month
monthEnd.summary: Period end, closes and the GL interface.

period.title: The period
period.body: Month end works on one period at a time; last month is selected.

status.title: Status
status.body: Open, soft closed or hard closed. A soft close can be reopened.

periodEnd.title: Period end
periodEnd.body: Revaluations and accruals for the month; running it again posts only the difference.

checklist.title: Hard close
checklist.body: What still blocks the hard close, such as an export the ERP has not acknowledged.

ledger.title: Ledger
ledger.body: The hash-chained journal: corrections are reversals, never edits.

admin.title: Master data and audit
admin.summary: Reference data, four-eyes changes and the audit trail.

reference.title: Reference data
reference.body: Companies, counterparties, registries, devices and books, with their history.

changes.title: Change requests
changes.body: Sensitive data (registry and bank accounts) changes only with a second person's approval.

audit.title: Audit trail
audit.body: Every change with who, when and why.

demo.title: The demo
demo.body: The administrator can reset the demo; it is rebuilt every night anyway.

ui.notFound: This part is not on the screen right now; read on or move to the next step.
ui.guideDescription: Short guided scenarios. Each switches personas for you where a second person is needed.
ui.takeTour: Take the tour of this screen
ui.welcomeBody: This is a working system with fictitious companies and prices. You act as personas: switch from the menu at the top right to play each role, including the second person every approval needs.
ui.welcomeShared: Everyone shares the same data, and it is rebuilt every night.
